planets.name: TOI-1759 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1759 with a 18.8-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1759 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1759. Its orbit and size follow Espinoza et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
